text: Skita presents itself as 'Skita Sportwear équipementier sportif', a French kit maker whose site says it equips clubs for training and competition; no parent company, fund or state owner is named anywhere on the site.
short: Skita is a self-owned French sportswear maker; no parent identified.

source.name: skita.fr (official site, homepage and footer)
source.quote: Skita Sportwear équipementier sportif ... SKITA vous accompagne à l’entrainement et dans la compétition
source.note: skita.fr was fetched via its resolved IP (83.166.138.63) because the hostname did not resolve locally.

additionalSources.name: Footy Headlines: FC Arouca 26-27 Home Kit Released
additionalSources.quote: The Skita logo is placed on the right chest in navy, sitting opposite the traditional club crest, with main sponsor bwin printed across the front.
additionalSources.note: Establishes the sponsor link: Skita is FC Arouca's kit maker for 2026-27. Footy Headlines calls Skita a 'domestic manufacturer', but the brand is French (skita.fr) - the wording is theirs, not ours.
